value.name: Miles frantically calls Joe
value.description: Miles paces with the telephone and urgently dials Joe while visibly shaken.
evidence: He punches numbers with the thumb of the hand holding the phone; his other hand holds a coffee cup from which he takes trembling slurps.
VOICE This is Joe. Wuddya need?

value.name: Miles orders Joe to abort the plan
value.description: Miles identifies himself and tells Joe to stop whatever was planned regarding Marylin, insisting it is a no-go.
evidence: MILES Joe. This is Mr. uh... friend of -- we met. This is to instruct you it's No Go!
Do you understand me?! NO GO on Marylin Rexroth Doyle -- No Go.

value.name: Miles hangs up abruptly
value.description: After issuing the warning, Miles slams down the phone in panic.

value.name: Kenneth questions the call
value.description: Kenneth asks who Miles was speaking to, prompting Miles's realization that the warning may have come too late.
evidence: MILES That was -- oh, shit. What if he's on his way over there?

value.name: Miles realizes his mistake
value.description: Miles becomes consumed with remorse and fears that Joe may already be heading toward Marylin.
evidence: MILES Marylin! What have I done?

value.name: Kenneth makes a joke
value.description: Kenneth responds to Miles's distress with a sarcastic remark about not being called Marylin.
evidence: KENNETH I don't know, but don't call me Marylin.

value.name: Miles drives to intercept Joe
value.description: Miles speeds away in his car while using the car phone to urgently tell someone to get Marylin out and buy time.
evidence: Miles drives, speeding, taking corners hard while punching numbers into his car phone.
MILES Get her out, buy some time; get her out --
